_comment: An ordinary Age: open overhead and lit. It names no sky or fog colour, deliberately — in 26.1 a biome carries its own as an attribute map, so naming one here pins every biome in the Age to it, and a plains Age and a swamp Age had the same sky. `ambient_light_color` is different and must be stated: the attribute's registered default is #000000, so a type that says nothing about it is blacker than any world in the game. #0a0a0a is vanilla's own overworld value, which is the world this type restates. `ambient_light` is a separate system and is not the one you can see — it reaches only `LevelReader.getBrightness`, where the lightmap is built from `ambient_light_color`, `sky_light_color` and `sky_light_factor`.
